name: LIF Population
description: A population of Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neurons.

parameters.name: n_neurons
parameters.label: Number of Neurons
parameters.description: Total number of neurons in the population.

parameters.name: tau_rc
parameters.label: Membrane Time Constant
parameters.description: Controls how quickly the membrane voltage decays back to resting state.

parameters.name: tau_ref
parameters.label: Refractory Period
parameters.description: Time the neuron is unable to spike after an action potential.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Spike Threshold
parameters.description: Membrane potential threshold used by canonical CNL export and hardware handoff flows.

cnl_template: Define a LIF neuron named {name} with time constant {tau_rc} and firing threshold {threshold}.
